tools.name: create_shapes

tools.name: offset_path

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agents" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inspect_path · Private data: create_shapes, create_path, pencil, edit_path, create_layout, update_layout, design_tokens, define_styles, describe_document, check_contacts, export_code, export_document, read_screen, get_assets, upload_asset · Public sink: create_shapes, create_path, pencil, edit_path, create_layout, update_layout, design_tokens, define_styles, add_artboard, draw_svg, compare_drawing, export_document, upload_asset · Destructive: set_artboard, delete_shapes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: inspect_path · Private data: create_shapes, create_path, pencil, edit_path, create_layout, update_layout, design_tokens, define_styles, describe_document, check_contacts, export_code, export_document, read_screen, get_assets, upload_asset · Public sink: create_shapes, create_path, pencil, edit_path, create_layout, update_layout, design_tokens, define_styles, add_artboard, draw_svg, compare_drawing, export_document, upload_asset · Destructive: set_artboard, delete_shapes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
